C Y Ho (JOLLY COMPANION) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that approaching the 300 Metres he shifted his mount out when insufficiently clear of GIANT BALLON, resulting in GIANT BALLON being taken out across the running of LOVING VIBES, resulting in LOVING VIBES having to be checked.  C Y Ho was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Wednesday, 11 February 2026 at Happy Valley.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his excellent race riding record.  When questioned M Guyon stated that in the early stages he was able to hold a position behind FLASH STAR.  He said near the 800 Metres when GIANT BALLON improved to his outside he raced in restricted room for a short distance to the inside of that runner and when he was aware JOLLY COMPANION was positioned to his inside he was obliged to remain racing one-off.  He said as he had expected FLASH STAR to continue forward and lead he did not contest the position behind that runner and as a consequence GIANT BALLON was able to cross to obtain a trailing position behind FLASH STAR.  He said when FLASH STAR then remained racing one-off the rail this resulted in LOVING VIBES racing keenly and shifting out and being obliged to race further back as a consequence.  After considering his explanation the Stewards advised Jockey Guyon that in the circumstances he had made an error of judgement by not attempting to hold his position to the inside of GIANT BALLON to avoid losing ground in the middle stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when racing in restricted room between YOUNG BRAVO and SMART CITY.  When questioned Z Purton stated that throughout the event his mount did not appreciate racing inside CAN’T GO WONG and as a result travelled only fairly.  When questioned regarding his riding approaching the 300 Metres and the reason he shifted to the inside of CAN’T GO WONG Jockey Purton stated that his mount was under pressure at this point and when he observed SMART CITY shifting to the outside of STORM RUNNER he was of the opinion the run to the outside of CAN’T GO WONG would close and for this reason he elected to shift to the inside of CAN’T GO WONG to continue into clear running.  He added in the Home Straight AMAZING GAZE responded only fairly to his riding.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.

A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  <5/2/2026 Amendment to Suspension – Apprentice E C W Wong> At the Happy Valley racemeeting conducted on Wednesday, 4 February 2026, Apprentice E C W Wong was found guilty of a charge of careless riding and was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong racemeeting to be conducted on Sunday, 22 February 2026, in addition to being fined the sum of $25,000.  Stewards have subsequently acceded to a request from Apprentice Wong to vary the date of the suspension and accordingly he is now suspended from riding at the Sha Tin racemeeting to be conducted on Thursday, 19 February 2026.
